name: isreadyforlaunch.com
summary: Pre-launch site health checker that audits SEO, technical performance and accessibility for a URL.
description: Enter a URL and get a passed/warnings/errors audit across SEO and technical checks: title and meta tags, canonical, Open Graph, structured data, headings, alt text, security headers and Core Web Vitals. Results can be shared and copied as an LLM fix prompt, and guide pages explain each check.
contains: single-URL audit with passed, warnings and errors results
checks: title tag, meta description, canonical, favicon, viewport, html lang, H1, heading hierarchy, image alt text
checks: Open Graph, Twitter card, structured data, PWA metadata
performance checks: LCP, CLS, total blocking time, broken assets, JavaScript runtime errors
security checks: HTTPS, HSTS, security headers, CSP quality
shareable result and copyable LLM fix prompt
guide page per check and a separate SSL certificate checker tool
